proposal.reason: Primary change is enqueue/runtime stream behavior: graphUsageMode is threaded through strong-stream acquire/release and capture detection, and P2P planning logic in enqueue is altered. Additional device-topology review is needed because src/graph/paths.cc substantively changes topology-driven P2P channel computation, including explicit nChannelsPerNetPeer handling and maxP2pPeers-based channel tuning/capping across multi-node peers.
